name: Brandon Wilkins
source: The protagonist, He’s fairly normal, aside from being a bit geeky and having a little self doubt at times. He normally spent most of his time locked up in his room playing video games and watching anime. He’s still a virgin with no hope of ever getting a girlfriend or laid. He chose to hack into the academy on a whim that it’d be his best chance for him and his friends to gain girlfriends, seeing it was an all girl school.
